source_semantics.registration_only: Enqueue/EnqueueCore registers a real tracked execution. Execution Center does not advance the row on its own; the originating runtime remains authoritative for progress, completion and failure.
source_semantics.validation: The owner/site overload rejects empty identities. EnqueueCore requires nonblank title and type, trims title/type/site name, clamps totalItems to at least one, and trims optional idempotency/correlation metadata.
source_semantics.initial_state: A new tracked job is Waiting with zero progress and zero processed items, null start/completion/error state, and one initial registration activity.
source_semantics.persistence: The registration and initial activity are committed together so a partial job/activity registration is not accepted as success.

laravel_adaptation.ledger_mapping: The existing operation_executions and operation_logs ledgers represent the canonical execution registration and initial activity; no competing execution persistence is introduced.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_owner_site_scope: Laravel intentionally strengthens the source boundary: an active TenantContext is mandatory, the supplied owner must be the active membership user, operations.manage is required server-side, and the supplied site must exist inside the active tenant.
laravel_adaptation.state_mapping: Canonical Waiting maps to Laravel queued. progress and processed_items remain zero, total_items is clamped to at least one, execution_mode remains Tracked, and start/completion/failure remain null.
laravel_adaptation.identity_mapping: The Laravel ledger requires a UUID correlation identifier; a supplied nonblank correlation ID is preserved and an omitted one is generated. Optional idempotency metadata is trimmed and retained in the redacted payload.
laravel_adaptation.activity_mapping: Exactly one info-level registration log is written in the same transaction and carries the canonical operation ID/source marker without claiming runtime progress or completion.
laravel_adaptation.redaction: Credential-like assignments in user-provided title/site/type text and structured payload/context are redacted before persistence or return.
